data.title: 小木曾雪菜 · 唱片店的试听
data.description: 唱片店里，她把耳机的一侧贴近耳朵，低头查看手中的专辑封面。
data.action: listening with headphones and holding an album cover
data.promptProse: At a listening station in a vibrant retro record store, Setsuna holds oversized DJ headphones against her ears, smiling radiantly as the opening chords of a favorite vocal track play. Shelves of colorful CD cases, indie band posters, and warm neon store lights surround her joyful, music-filled enthusiasm.
